summary.en: A question asked one word per beat at one fixed anchor; each word opens on the next ground of a lightness ramp through an aperture while its machine form types into the query line.
summary.zh: 问题一拍一个词落在同一个锚点上；每个词通过一个几何开口换到明度阶梯的下一级底色，同时它的机器写法打进下方查询行。

fits: The question of a film that answers it: the hook (the first word slams on beat 1) or the turn after an invert.
notFor: Copy over five words a state; statements that are not a question or a query; long words that would need to move the anchor.

intent.en: The eye never moves: one word per beat on the same spot, the ground flipping under it, so the question lands as rhythm and the query under it says it is real.
intent.zh: 视线不用移动：同一位置一拍一个词，底色在下面翻，问题变成节奏；下方的查询行说明它是真的。

content.en: 2–6 words or short phrases (≤ 14 chars, ≤ 5 words a state), each with an optional machine form (≤ 34 chars of code).
content.zh: 2–6 个词或短语（每个 ≤ 5 字，一个状态 ≤ 5 个词），每个可带一段机器写法（≤ 34 个字符的代码）。

fits.zh: 要回答一个问题的片子里的提问：钩子（第一个词在第 1 拍砸下）或反转后的提问。

notFor.zh: 一个状态超过五个词；不是问题或查询的陈述；长到要挪动锚点的词。

pairs.note: the question run over the candidates

en: Never move the anchor for a long word: split the question into two asks.
Do not crossfade grounds: every change is an aperture or an invert.
zh: 不要为长词挪锚点：把问题拆成两段提问。
底色不许淡入淡出：每次换底都是开口或反白。

overlaps.note: there a stem holds and one slot cycles; here every word replaces the last at one anchor and the ground flips

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
